name: io.github.d00mus/mcp-ssh-gateway
title: MCP SSH Gateway
description: SSH terminals for AI agents: stateful shells, exit codes the moment a command ends, router CLIs.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_SERVERS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON file with SSH server targets, or an inline JSON string. Overridden by --servers-config.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where logs and known_hosts are kept. Default: the user cache directory.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true/1 to force the global read-only guardrail.
